note: Traditional-only characters: each one has a distinct Simplified form, so a Simplified conversation that carries three or more of them in one thinking block is thinking in Traditional. Deliberately short and hand-checked - a character that is identical in both scripts (for example the ones for history, direction, answer) makes the check fire on ordinary Simplified prose, which is exactly what version 1 did.
